newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring bids up on MGE gain.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring bids up on MGE gain.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were higher on Wednesday, responding largely to gains in MGE spring wheat futures, cash merchants said.
Farmer selling was virtually nonexistent in Minnesota and North Dakota as producers opted to work in the fields and wait for higher prices.
"Yesterday and today were just dead," a Minnesota dealer said. "We've taken the flat price down far enough that the farmer selling has really shut down."
Cold weather continued to raise concerns of slow emergence in parts of North Dakota and Montana.
"We're finally getting some clear skies but we really need some heat units," one Montana dealer said.

Long-range forecasts offered some hope. The National Weather Service six- to 10-day outlook released on Wednesday predicted normal temperatures from June 3 to June 7 with normal to above normal precipitation.
